headline: Kai, 162,000 jobs later, the market is bracing for a September hike.
subline: Hike odds hit 63% for the Sept. 16 decision, stocks slipped while bitcoin held above $81,000, and CPI lands Friday.
asof: Weekend edition · market figures are Friday's close, bitcoin as of Friday · every figure links to a source below

items.title: Payrolls tripled the forecast; unemployment held at 4.1%
items.sentence: August added 162,000 jobs against a 55,000 consensus, and the S&P 500 gave back 0.38% as the 10-year yield rose to 4.78%, per TheStreet.

items.title: Rate-hike odds for September reached 63%
items.sentence: Treasury yields jumped as futures priced a 63% chance the Fed hikes this month, with July's payroll reading revised from negative to positive, per Charles Schwab.

items.title: Lululemon fell to seven-year lows on cut guidance
items.sentence: The retailer cut its full-year outlook as China sales fell 4% year over year, one of Friday's sharpest single-stock moves, per Investrade's market review.

items.title: Bitcoin holds above $81,000 on heavy ETF inflows
items.sentence: Friday brought the largest spot-ETF inflow in nine months after Fed governor Waller's comments, per Yahoo Finance. The move leaves bitcoin up 28.1% over the past month, though still 27.3% below a year ago.

items.title: The docket: PPI Thursday, CPI Friday, Fed next week
items.sentence: Markets are closed Monday for Labor Day; then PPI lands September 10 and CPI September 11, the last inflation reads before the FOMC's September 15–16 meeting, with the funds rate at 3.50%–3.75%, per GO Markets.

items.title: Germany's AfD poised for a state-election breakthrough
items.sentence: A win in Saxony-Anhalt would give the far right its first state governorship since World War II, per NPR.

items.title: Gloria Steinem dies at 92
items.sentence: Tributes from politics and entertainment poured in for the pioneering feminist organizer and writer, per NPR.

items.title: ICE officer charged with lying about a shooting
items.sentence: The Justice Department says the officer misrepresented the circumstances of a Venezuelan immigrant's shooting, per NPR.

items.title: Heat deaths far exceed official counts
items.sentence: An NPR investigation with Boston University finds heat kills far more Americans than the records show.

items.title: Scientists map protein interactions behind profound autism
items.sentence: Research published in Science charts the interactions and points to new targets for drug development, per NPR.

items.title: Claude autonomously formalizes Fermat's Last Theorem
items.sentence: Working largely on its own for 11 days, the model produced 13 million lines of Lean proving the theorem from Lean's three standard axioms, per Anthropic.

items.title: Anthropic's IPO marketing moves to mid-October
items.sentence: Reuters reports the roadshow now begins in mid-October at the earliest, per CNBC.

items.title: OpenAI says Astra is harder to monitor
items.sentence: GPT-6's recurrent-depth design reasons in latent space rather than visible chains of thought, and OpenAI's own testing flags the lost oversight, per Implicator.

items.title: Figure books $3.5 billion of GPU compute
items.sentence: The Nscale partnership deploys up to 100,000 Nvidia GPUs to train Figure's Helix humanoid models, per the companies' announcement.

items.title: OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google all stumbled this week
items.sentence: All three suffered brief outages within two days of one another — even frontier labs take the occasional long lunch — per Crypto Briefing.
